scope: Cedar and Maple Message transition/service completion ownership
verificationKind: Simulated component completion protocol, real Vue in JSDOM, and source contract; not native browser/OS

reproduction.problem: A held component completion was bypassed by the 200ms service fallback.
reproduction.candidateRegression: Removing the fallback initially leaked two creation-tick close/clear cases on both platforms; resolved with never-mounted direct cleanup. These failures arose during this candidate implementation, not the original baseline.
reproduction.componentSourceFinding: Both Transition templates forced duration=150 despite public CSS duration tokens.

after.motionGate: passed: 8 source/scanner tests, 190-file inventory and existing compiled motion chain

behavior: Mounted service entries wait for actual component after-leave/closed; fixed 150ms Transition duration and 200ms disposal fallback removed.
Never-mounted close/clear directly cleans the entry and calls service onClosed without inventing component animation events.
Snapshot clear does not skip synchronously removed unmounted entries.
Completion while an item is reopened remains ignored; removed entries cannot complete twice.
Existing CSS token defaults and business display durations remain unchanged.
harnessCorrections: Cedar existing VTU mounts used default Transition stubs, which never report CSS closed to subsequent service renders. Explicit real Transition and wrapper unmount restored complete regression; not a product defect.
Completion protocol uses a bounded doMock/dynamic import and explicit doUnmock/resetModules cleanup, not a persistent hoisted module mock.
A temporary read-only completion diagnostic passed and was removed; one new test string formatting error was corrected before final successful suites.

inventory.meaning: candidates, not accepted cases or defects

next: Real IAB two-platform default/long/zero/reopen and lifecycle acceptance; actual CSS consumption checks. Custom nested animations remain caller-owned.
constraints: No Token default/API change, commits, push, releases, new chats or subagents; unrelated date/naming work and Button white foreground exception preserved.
